name: Xiaochangshu (Small Intestine Shu)
location_text: On the lower back over the sacrum (the flat bone above the tailbone), two finger-widths out from the midline, a little above the dimple that sits over the buttock.

name: Pangguangshu (Bladder Shu)
location_text: On the flat bone at the base of the spine (sacrum), two finger-widths out from the midline, level with the dimples above the buttocks.

name: Zhonglushu (Central Backbone Shu)
location_text: On the flat bone at the base of the spine (sacrum), two finger-widths out from the midline, about one thumb-width below the level of the dimples above the buttocks.

name: Baihuanshu (White Ring Shu)
location_text: On the lower back over the sacrum (the flat bone above the tailbone), two finger-widths out from the midline, near the bottom of the sacrum, close to where the buttock crease begins.

name: Shangliao (Upper Bone Hole)
location_text: On the sacrum, in the small dent just above the buttock dimple, about halfway between the spine line and the bony bump of the hip.

name: Ciliao (Second Bone Hole)
location_text: On the sacrum, in the small dent level with the dimple above the buttock, about halfway between that dimple (the bony bump of the hip) and the spine line.

name: Zhongliao (Middle Bone Hole)
location_text: On the sacrum, in the third small dent from the top, about one thumb-width below the level of the dimples, between the midline and the dimple line.

name: Xialiao (Lower Bone Hole)
location_text: On the lowest part of the sacrum, in the fourth small dent from the top, near the start of the buttock crease, between the midline and the dimple line.

name: Huiyang (Meeting of Yang)
location_text: Right beside the very tip of the tailbone, in the soft hollow about half a thumb-width to the side of the buttock cleft.

name: Baohuang (Bladder Huang)
location_text: On the upper buttock, about four finger-widths out from the central ridge of the tailbone area, level with the second hollow in the sacrum.

name: Zhibian (Sequential Limit)
location_text: On the buttock, about four finger-widths out from the notch just above the buttock cleft, level with the lowest hollow of the sacrum.

name: Kunlun (Kunlun Mountains)
location_text: On the outer ankle, in the hollow between the bump of the outer ankle bone and the Achilles tendon.

name: Zhiyin (Reaching Yin)
location_text: On the little toe, at the outer side of the nail, a hair's breadth behind the corner of the toenail.

name: Huiyin (Meeting of Yin)
location_text: In the soft area between the anus and the genitals, at the midpoint.

name: Qugu (Curved Bone)
location_text: On the lower belly, on the midline, just above the top edge of the pubic bone.

name: Zhongji (Central Pole)
location_text: On the lower belly, on the midline, about four thumb-widths below the navel.

name: Guanyuan (Gate of Origin)
location_text: On the lower belly, on the midline, about three thumb-widths (four finger-widths) below the navel.

name: Shimen (Stone Gate)
location_text: On the lower belly, on the midline, about two thumb-widths below the navel.

name: Qihai (Sea of Qi)
location_text: On the lower belly, on the midline, about one and a half thumb-widths (two finger-widths) below the navel.

name: Yinjiao (Yin Intersection)
location_text: On the lower belly, on the midline, about one thumb-width below the navel.

name: Shenque (Spirit Gate Tower)
location_text: In the centre of the navel, inside the belly button.

name: Shiqizhuixia (Below the 17th Vertebra)
location_text: On the middle line of the low back, in the small hollow just below the last bony bump of the low back, where it meets the sacrum.

name: Yaoqi (Extraordinary Lumbar Point)
location_text: On the middle line of the lower back, on the flat triangular bone at the base of the spine (the sacrum), three finger-widths above the tip of the tailbone, in the small dip there.
dispute_note: References differ on the height. This follows the version two thumb-widths above the tip of the tailbone.

name: Zigong (Uterus)
location_text: On the lower belly: one hand-width plus one thumb-width below the navel, then one hand-width (four finger-widths) out to the side.

name: Juquan (Gathering Spring)
location_text: In the mouth, on the middle of the tongue top when the tongue is stuck fully out.

name: Haiquan (Sea Spring)
location_text: In the mouth, under the tongue, in the middle of the fold of skin holding the tongue down.

name: Jinjin (Golden Fluid)
location_text: In the mouth, under the left side of the tongue, on the vein beside the central fold of skin.

name: Yuye (Jade Fluid)
location_text: In the mouth, under the right side of the tongue, on the vein beside the central fold of skin.

name: Qiuhou (Behind the Ball)
location_text: On the lower rim of the eye socket, about one quarter of the way in from the outer corner of the eye.

name: Neiyingxiang (Inner Welcome Fragrance)
location_text: Inside the nostril, high up, where the nose meets the upper lining.

name: Duyin (Solitary Yin)
location_text: On the underside of the second toe, in the middle of the crease at the joint nearest the toenail.

name: Jianjing (Shoulder Well)
location_text: On top of the shoulder, halfway between the bump at the base of the neck and the outer tip of the shoulder, on the thick muscle you can squeeze.

name: Wushu (Fifth Pivot)
location_text: On the side of the lower belly, just inside the front point of the hip bone, level with a spot four finger-widths below the belly button.

name: Weidao (Linking Path)
location_text: On the lower belly, a half thumb-width below and slightly toward the middle from the front point of the hip bone.

name: Changqiang (Long Strong)
location_text: Between the tip of the tailbone and the anus, in the perineal area.

name: Yaoshu (Lumbar Shu)
location_text: At the very bottom of the spine, in the small dip just above where the buttock crease begins, on the midline.

name: Yinjiao (Gum Intersection)
location_text: Inside the mouth, where the small fold of skin joining the upper lip meets the upper gum, on the midline.

name: Jiquan (Highest Spring)
location_text: In the center of the armpit hollow, directly over the artery and nerves.

name: Henggu (Pubic Bone)
location_text: On the lowest part of the belly just above the pubic bone, about half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Dahe (Great Manifestation)
location_text: On the lower belly, about four thumb-widths below the navel, half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Qixue (Qi Point)
location_text: On the lower belly, about four finger-widths below the navel, half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Siman (Fourfold Fullness)
location_text: On the lower belly, about three finger-widths below the navel, half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Zhongzhu (Middle Flow)
location_text: On the lower belly, about one thumb-width below the navel, half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Hegu (Joining Valley)
location_text: On the back of the hand, on the thumb side of the index-finger hand bone, about halfway along it, in the fleshy web between thumb and index finger.

name: Jimai (Urgent Pulse)
location_text: In the groin crease, level with the top of the pubic bone and about two and a half thumb-widths out from the midline, where you may feel the groin pulse nearby; press beside the pulse, not on it.

name: Zhizheng (Branch of the Upright)
location_text: On the little-finger side of the back of the forearm, about six to seven finger-widths above the wrist, along the edge of the forearm bone.

name: Chongmen (Surging Gate)
location_text: In the fold where the thigh meets the lower belly, a little outside the pulse you can feel in the groin, level with the top of the pubic bone.

name: Fushe (Abode of the Bowels)
location_text: On the lower belly, four thumb-widths (a hand-width plus a thumb-width) out from the midline, a little above the crease where the thigh meets the pelvis.

name: Fujie (Abdominal Knot)
location_text: On the lower belly, a little more than a thumb-width below the level of the navel and four thumb-widths (a hand-width plus a thumb-width) out to the side.

name: Sanyinjiao (Three Yin Intersection)
location_text: On the inside of the lower leg, about four finger-widths above the tip of the inner ankle bone, just behind the edge of the shin bone.

name: Chengqi (Container of Tears)
location_text: On the face, straight below the pupil when looking ahead, right on the edge of the lower eye socket, at the point where the eyeball sits just above.

name: Ruzhong (Middle of the Breast)
location_text: At the centre of the nipple. It is used only as a measuring landmark for the chest and abdomen, not as a treatment point.

name: Tianshu (Celestial Pivot)
location_text: On the belly, level with the navel and two thumb-widths out to the side of it.

name: Wailing (Outer Mound)
location_text: On the lower belly, one thumb-width below the navel and two thumb-widths out to the side of the midline.

name: Daju (Great Gigantic)
location_text: On the lower belly, two thumb-widths below the navel and two thumb-widths out to the side of the midline.

name: Shuidao (Waterway)
location_text: On the lower belly, three thumb-widths below the navel and two thumb-widths out to the side of the midline.

name: Guilai (Return)
location_text: On the lower belly, four thumb-widths below the navel and two thumb-widths out to the side of the midline, just above the pubic bone.

name: Qichong (Rushing Qi)
location_text: In the crease where the lower belly meets the thigh, level with the top of the pubic bone and two thumb-widths out from the midline. Feel for the pulse and press beside it.

name: Renying (Man's Welcome)
location_text: On the front of the neck beside the Adam's apple, just in front of the large neck muscle, right where you feel the pulse of the carotid artery.

name: Yaotongdian (Low Back Pain Point)
location_text: On the back of the hand, two points: one between the index and middle finger bones and one between the ring and little finger bones, about halfway from wrist to knuckles.
dispute_note: References differ on whether these sit midway between wrist and knuckles or nearer the wrist. This follows the midway version.

name: Muchuang (Eye Window)
location_text: On the scalp, straight above the pupil, about two finger-widths back from the front hairline.
dispute_note: Older references place this a little further back from the hairline. This follows the WHO 2008 measurement.

name: Zhengying (Upright Nutrition)
location_text: On the scalp straight above the pupil, about two and a half thumb-widths (three to four finger-widths) back from the front hairline.
dispute_note: Older references place this a little further back from the hairline. This follows the WHO 2008 measurement.

name: Chengling (Support Spirit)
location_text: On the scalp, straight above the pupil, about four thumb-widths back from the front hairline.
dispute_note: Older references place this a little further back from the hairline. This follows the WHO 2008 measurement.

name: Zhejin (Sinew Seat)
location_text: On the side of the chest, a thumb-width in front of the midline of the armpit, in the groove between the ribs about level with the nipple.
dispute_note: WHO places this in the 4th rib gap; some references use the 5th.

name: Fengshi (Wind Market)
location_text: On the outer thigh, where the tip of your middle finger lands when you stand with your arms hanging straight down.
dispute_note: WHO describes this only as where your middle fingertip rests with your arms by your sides. Some references give a fixed seven thumb-widths above the knee crease.

name: Zhongdu (Central River)
location_text: On the outer thigh, about seven thumb-widths (a little over two hand-widths) above the outer end of the back-of-knee crease, just behind the thick band along the outer thigh.
dispute_note: WHO places this seven thumb-widths above the knee crease; some older references give five.

name: Shuigou (Water Trough)
location_text: On the midline of the upper lip, in the vertical groove under the nose, around its middle or a little nearer the nose.
dispute_note: WHO places this in the middle of the groove under the nose; many references use the spot one third of the way down. Either is fine.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Anmian (Peaceful Sleep)
location_text: Behind the ear: find the soft hollow just behind the earlobe and the hollow under the base of the skull at the side of the neck. The point is halfway between them, just behind the bony bump behind the ear. Press lightly.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Weizhong (Middle of the Crook)
location_text: At the center of the crease behind the knee, in the middle of the hollow, with the leg relaxed.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Chengshan (Mountain Support)
location_text: On the back of the calf, in the V-shaped notch where the two calf-muscle bulges taper into the Achilles tendon; rise onto your toes to see it.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Jingbailao (Neck Hundred Taxations)
location_text: On the back of the neck: find the hollow just below the big bump at the base of the neck, go two thumb-widths straight up, then one thumb-width out to the side.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Yintang (Hall of Impression)
location_text: On the forehead, in the flat spot exactly halfway between the inner ends of your eyebrows.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Taiyang (Sun / Supreme Yang)
location_text: In the soft hollow of the temple, about one thumb-width behind the middle of the line from the outer end of the eyebrow to the outer corner of the eye.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Wailaogong (Luozhen) (Outer Palace of Toil / Stiff Neck Point)
location_text: On the back of the hand, in the tender hollow between the index and middle finger bones, about half a thumb-width behind the knuckles.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Fengchi (Wind Pool)
location_text: At the base of the skull, in the hollow between the two thick neck cords at the back and the muscle that runs up behind the ear, below the ridge of the skull.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Shenmen (Spirit Gate)
location_text: On the palm side of the wrist, in the small hollow on the little-finger side of the crease, just beside the tendon and the small bone there.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Yongquan (Gushing Spring)
location_text: On the sole, in the dip that appears when you curl your toes, about a third of the way from the base of the toes to the heel.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Quchi (Pool at the Bend)
location_text: With the elbow bent, at the outer end of the elbow crease, in the dip on the thumb side just before the bony knob.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Taichong (Great Rushing)
location_text: On the top of the foot, in the hollow between the big-toe and second-toe bones, just toe-side of where they join; you can feel the foot pulse here.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Lieque (Broken Sequence)
location_text: On the thumb side of the forearm, about two finger-widths above the wrist crease, in the groove next to the bony bump at the wrist.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Neiguan (Inner Pass)
location_text: On the inner forearm, between the two central tendons, about three finger-widths above the wrist crease. Make a fist to see the tendons.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Houxi (Back Ravine)
location_text: On the outer edge of the hand, in the dip just behind the little-finger knuckle. Make a loose fist and look for the end of the crease below the little finger.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Wangu (Wrist Bone)
location_text: On the outer edge of the hand, in the soft dip at the wrist end of the bone that leads to the little finger, just before the wrist bone.

why: shown first in a symptom routine
name: Zusanli (Leg Three Miles)
location_text: On the front of the lower leg, about four finger-widths below the kneecap's lower edge and one finger-width outside the shin bone, in the muscle.

name: Dingchuan (Calm Wheezing)
location_text: On the upper back, just beside the spine at the base of the bony bump at the bottom of the neck, about half a thumb-width out to the side.

name: Jiaji (Huatuojiaji) (Huatuo Paravertebral Points)
location_text: A row of points on each side of the spine, from the top of the upper back down to the low back, each about half a thumb-width out from the bony bumps of the spine.

name: Weiwanxiashu (Lower Stomach Back Point)
location_text: On the mid-back: find the spine bump level with the bottom tips of the shoulder blades, go one bump lower, then two finger-widths out to the side, level with the gap just below that bump.

name: Pigen (Root of Mass)
location_text: On the low back: find the first bump of the low back (three bumps above the one level with the hip-bone tops), then go one hand-width plus half a thumb-width out to the side, level with the gap just below it.

name: Xiajishu (Lower Extremity Shu)
location_text: On the low back, in the middle line of the spine, just under the third bony bump of the low back.

name: Yaoyi (Lumbar Suitability)
location_text: On the low back: find the spine bump level with the tops of the hip bones, then go one hand-width (four finger-widths) out to the side, level with the gap just below it.

name: Yaoyan (Lumbar Eye)
location_text: On the low back, in the dimple one hand-width plus half a thumb-width out from the spine, level with the gap below the spine bump that lines up with the tops of the hip bones.

name: Sishencong (Four Alert Spirit)
location_text: On the top of the head, a set of four spots: one thumb-width in front of, behind, and to each side of the very top of the head.

name: Yiming (Eye Brightening)
location_text: Behind the ear, on the back edge of the bony bump behind the ear, about one thumb-width behind the soft hollow below the earlobe.

name: Dangyang (Facing Yang)
location_text: On the front of the scalp, straight up from the pupil when you look ahead, one thumb-width back from the front hairline.

name: Yuyao (Fish Waist)
location_text: On the eyebrow, at its middle, directly above the pupil when you look straight ahead. Stay on the brow bone.

name: Erjian (Ear Apex)
location_text: At the very top of the ear. Fold the ear forward and it is at the tip of the fold.

name: Shangyingxiang (Upper Welcome Fragrance (Bitong))
location_text: On the face, at the top end of the groove running from the side of the nostril, where the nose cartilage meets the bone.

name: Kuangu (Hip Bone)
location_text: Front of the thigh: find the spot three finger-widths above the outer top corner of the kneecap. The two points sit two finger-widths to the outside and two finger-widths to the inside of that spot.

name: Bafeng (Eight Winds)
location_text: On the top of the foot, in the four hollows between neighbouring toes, just behind the toe webs. Four points on each foot.

name: Qiduan (End of Qi)
location_text: At the tip of each of the ten toes, just beyond the nail edge. Press with the edge of a fingernail.

name: Heding (Crane's Top)
location_text: Just above the kneecap, in the small hollow at the middle of its upper edge.

name: Baichongwo (Hundred Insects Burrow)
location_text: Inner front of the thigh: one hand-width (four finger-widths) straight up from the inner top corner of the kneecap, on the bulge of the inner thigh muscle.

name: Neixiyan (Inner Knee Eye)
location_text: With the knee bent, in the soft dip just below the kneecap on the inner side of the thick tendon.

name: Xiyan (Eyes of the Knee)
location_text: With the knee bent, in the two soft dips just below the kneecap, one on each side of the thick tendon. The inner dip is Neixiyan.

name: Dannang (Gallbladder Point)
location_text: Outer side of the lower leg: find the bony knob below the outer knee and the hollow just below and in front of it. Go three finger-widths further down from that hollow and press for the tender spot.

name: Lanwei (Appendix Point)
location_text: Front of the lower leg: one hand-width plus three finger-widths below the bottom of the kneecap, one finger-width outside the shin bone. Press for the tender spot.

name: Neihuaijian (Inner Ankle Tip)
location_text: On the inner side of the ankle, at the very top of the rounded bony bump.

name: Waihuaijian (Outer Ankle Tip)
location_text: On the outer side of the ankle, at the very top of the rounded bony bump.

name: Zhoujian (Elbow Tip)
location_text: On the back of the elbow, at the very tip of the pointed bone that sticks out when you bend your arm.

name: Sifeng (Four Seams)
location_text: On the palm side of the index, middle, ring and little fingers, at the centre of the middle crease of each finger (the joint halfway along). Four points on each hand.

name: Shixuan (Ten Diffusions)
location_text: At the very tip of each of the ten fingers, just beyond the nail edge. Press with the edge of a fingernail on each tip.

name: Erbai (Two Whites)
location_text: Inner forearm, a hand-width plus a thumb-width above the wrist crease. Two spots, one on each side of the tendon on the thumb side (it pops up when you bend the wrist toward the thumb).

name: Zhongquan (Middle Spring)
location_text: On the back of the wrist, in the hollow along the wrist crease just on the thumb side of the main finger-straightening tendon.

name: Zhongkui (Middle Finger Eminence)
location_text: On the back of the middle finger, at the centre of the middle joint (the knuckle halfway along the finger). Bend the finger slightly; it is at the top of the bent joint.

name: Dagukong (Large Bone Hollow)
location_text: On the back of the thumb, in the middle of the crease at the thumb's only knuckle joint.

name: Xiaogukong (Small Bone Hollow)
location_text: On the back of the little finger, at the centre of the middle joint (the knuckle halfway along the finger).

name: Baxie (Eight Pathogens)
location_text: On the back of the hand, in the four hollows between the knuckles of neighbouring fingers, just behind the finger webs. Four points on each hand.

name: Low back (ear) (Lumbosacral zone of the ear)
location_text: On the ear, along the raised inner ridge (not the outer rim), in its upper part, roughly a third of the way down from the top.

name: Jingming (Bright Eyes)
location_text: On the face, in the small dip just above and inside the inner corner of the eye, against the side of the nose bridge. Use very light pressure and keep the fingertip on the bone, not the eye.

name: Tianzhu (Heavenly Pillar)
location_text: On the back of the neck, just below the skull, in the hollow on the outer side of the thick vertical neck muscle, a thumb-width out from the midline.

name: Dazhu (Great Shuttle)
location_text: On the upper back. Find the big bump at the base of the neck, go down one more bump, then two finger-widths out from the spine, level with the lower edge of that second bump.

name: Fengmen (Wind Gate)
location_text: On the upper back, two finger-widths out from the spine, level with the second bump below the big bump at the base of the neck.

name: Feishu (Lung Shu)
location_text: On the upper back, about two finger-widths out from the spine, level with the line across the inner ends of the shoulder blade ridges.

name: Jueyinshu (Pericardium Shu)
location_text: Between the shoulder blades, two finger-widths out from the spine, one bump below the level of the inner ends of the shoulder-blade ridges.

name: Xinshu (Heart Shu)
location_text: Between the shoulder blades, two finger-widths out from the spine, two bumps below the level of the inner ends of the shoulder-blade ridges.

name: Dushu (Governor Shu)
location_text: On the mid-back, two finger-widths out from the spine, one bump above the level of the bottom tips of the shoulder blades.

name: Geshu (Diaphragm Shu)
location_text: On the mid-back, about two finger-widths out from the spine, level with the bottom tip of the shoulder blade.

name: Ganshu (Liver Shu)
location_text: On the mid-back, about two finger-widths out from the spine, two bone-bumps below the level of the bottom tips of the shoulder blades.

name: Danshu (Gallbladder Shu)
location_text: On the mid-back, two finger-widths out from the spine, three bumps below the level of the bottom tips of the shoulder blades.

name: Cuanzhu (Gathered Bamboo)
location_text: At the inner end of the eyebrow, in the small notch you can feel on the bone, straight above the inner corner of the eye.

name: Pishu (Spleen Shu)
location_text: On the mid-back, two finger-widths out from the spine, one bump above the last bone that carries a rib.

name: Weishu (Stomach Shu)
location_text: On the mid-back, about two finger-widths out from the spine, level with the last rib-bearing bone, about halfway between the shoulder blades and hips.

name: Sanjiaoshu (Triple Burner Shu)
location_text: On the lower back, two finger-widths out from the spine, level with the first bump below the last rib-bearing bone.

name: Shenshu (Kidney Transporter)
location_text: On the low back, two finger-widths out from the spine, level with the waist. It sits about halfway between the lowest rib and the top of the hip bone.

name: Qihaishu (Sea of Qi Shu)
location_text: On the low back, two finger-widths out from the spine, one bump above the level of the top of the hip bones.

name: Dachangshu (Large Intestine Shu)
location_text: On the low back, two finger-widths out from the spine, at the height of the top of the hip bones, where a belt line would cross.

name: Guanyuanshu (Gate of Origin Shu)
location_text: On the low back, two finger-widths out from the spine, one bump below the level of the top of the hip bones, just above the flat bone at the base of the spine.

name: Meichong (Eyebrow Ascent)
location_text: On the forehead, straight up from the inner end of the eyebrow, about half a thumb-width inside the hairline.

name: Chengfu (Hold and Support)
location_text: At the very middle of the crease where the buttock meets the back of the thigh.

name: Yinmen (Gate of Abundance)
location_text: On the back of the thigh, in the groove between the two hamstring muscles, a little above halfway down from the buttock crease to the knee crease (about two hand-widths below the buttock crease).

name: Fuxi (Floating Cleft)
location_text: On the back of the thigh just above the knee crease, on the inner side of the outer hamstring tendon, about one thumb-width above the crease.

name: Weiyang (Bend Yang)
location_text: At the outer end of the crease behind the knee, in the dent just inside the tight outer hamstring tendon.

name: Qucha (Deviating Turn)
location_text: At the front hairline, about two finger-widths out from the middle of the forehead hairline, half a thumb-width up into the hair.

name: Fufen (Attached Branch)
location_text: On the upper back, four finger-widths out from the spine, level with the top of the shoulder blade's inner edge. Reach across the body to find it, along the inner border of the shoulder blade.

name: Pohu (Door of the Corporeal Soul)
location_text: On the upper back, four finger-widths out from the spine, along the inner edge of the shoulder blade, level with the inner ends of the shoulder-blade ridges.

name: Gaohuang (Vital Region Shu)
location_text: On the upper back, four finger-widths out from the spine, on the inner edge of the shoulder blade at about its mid-height. Cross your arm over your chest to open the gap.

name: Shentang (Spirit Hall)
location_text: On the upper back, four finger-widths out from the spine, beside the inner edge of the shoulder blade, two bumps below the level of the inner ends of the shoulder-blade ridges.

name: Yixi (Yi Xi)
location_text: On the upper back, four finger-widths out from the spine, beside the lower inner edge of the shoulder blade, one bump above the level of its bottom tip.

name: Geguan (Diaphragm Gate)
location_text: On the upper back, about four finger-widths out from the spine, level with the lower tips of the shoulder blades.

name: Hunmen (Ethereal Soul Gate)
location_text: On the mid back, about four finger-widths out from the spine, two bony bumps of the spine below the level of the shoulder-blade tips.

name: Yanggang (Yang Headquarters)
location_text: On the mid back, about four finger-widths out from the spine, three bony bumps of the spine below the level of the shoulder-blade tips.

name: Yishe (Intention Dwelling)
location_text: On the lower part of the mid back, about four finger-widths out from the spine, four bony bumps below the level of the shoulder-blade tips.

name: Wuchu (Fifth Place)
location_text: On the scalp, one thumb-width behind the front hairline and two finger-widths out from the midline.

name: Weicang (Stomach Granary)
location_text: At the bottom of the ribs at the back, about four finger-widths out from the spine, level with the last rib-bearing bump of the spine.

name: Huangmen (Vital Region Gate)
location_text: On the lower back, about four finger-widths out from the spine, at the top of the waist just below the last rib's bump.

name: Zhishi (Will Chamber)
location_text: On the lower back, about four finger-widths out from the spine, one bony bump below the top of the waist, level with the kidneys.

name: Heyang (Yang Convergence)
location_text: On the back of the calf, in the groove between the two calf-muscle bulges, about three finger-widths below the middle of the back-of-knee crease.

name: Chengjin (Sinews Support)
location_text: On the back of the calf, in the thickest part of the calf muscle, about halfway between the middle of the back-of-knee crease and the V-shaped notch where the calf muscle ends.

name: Feiyang (Taking Flight)
location_text: On the outer back of the lower leg, about a thumb-width outward and below the V-notch of the calf muscle, roughly seven thumb-widths above the outer ankle bone.

name: Fuyang (Instep Yang)
location_text: On the outer back of the lower leg, between the thin outer leg bone and the Achilles tendon, about four finger-widths above the hollow behind the outer ankle bone.

name: Chengguang (Receiving Light)
location_text: On the top of the scalp, about two and a half thumb-widths behind the front hairline and two finger-widths out from the midline.

name: Pucan (Servant's Respect)
location_text: On the outer side of the heel, straight down from the hollow between the outer ankle bone and the Achilles tendon, on the side of the heel bone where darker and paler skin meet.

name: Shenmai (Extending Vessel)
location_text: On the outer side of the foot, in the hollow just below the bottom edge of the outer ankle bone.

name: Jinmen (Metal Gate)
location_text: On the outer edge of the foot, in front of and below the outer ankle bone, in the hollow just behind the bump on the little-toe side of the foot.

name: Jinggu (Capital Bone)
location_text: On the outer edge of the foot, just in front of the bony bump halfway along the foot, where darker skin meets paler skin.

name: Shugu (Restraining Bone)
location_text: On the outer edge of the foot, in the hollow just behind the knuckle of the little toe, where darker skin meets paler skin.

name: Zutonggu (Foot Penetrating Valley)
location_text: On the outer edge of the little toe's base, in the hollow just in front of the knuckle, where darker skin meets paler skin.

name: Tongtian (Penetrating Heaven)
location_text: On the top of the head, four thumb-widths behind the front hairline and two finger-widths out from the midline.

name: Luoque (Declining Connection)
location_text: On the top of the head, about five and a half thumb-widths behind the front hairline, two finger-widths out from the midline and a little behind the crown.

name: Yuzhen (Jade Pillow)
location_text: On the back of the head, about one thumb-width out from the midline, level with the top of the bony bump at the center of the skull base.

name: Bladder lines (low back) (Bladder channel lines of the low back)
location_text: Two vertical lines on each side of the lower back: an inner line about two finger-widths from the spine and an outer line about four finger-widths from it, level with the waist.

name: Xiawan (Lower Stomach Duct)
location_text: On the upper belly, on the midline, about two thumb-widths above the navel.

name: Jianli (Building Mile)
location_text: On the upper belly, on the midline, about three thumb-widths above the navel.

name: Zhongwan (Middle Stomach Duct)
location_text: On the upper belly, on the midline, halfway between the navel and the point where the lower end of the breastbone meets the rib arch (not the loose tip below it), about four thumb-widths above the navel.

name: Shangwan (Upper Stomach Cavity)
location_text: On the belly midline, about four finger-widths plus two thumb-widths above the navel, a little more than halfway from the navel up to the bottom of the breastbone.

name: Juque (Great Palace Gate)
location_text: On the belly midline, about two thumb-widths below where the ribs meet at the bottom of the breastbone (roughly four finger-widths plus three thumb-widths above the navel).

name: Jiuwei (Turtledove Tail)
location_text: On the midline, one thumb-width below the spot where the flat breastbone ends and its small pointed tip begins. Press lightly.

name: Zhongting (Central Palace)
location_text: On the midline of the chest, right at the bottom of the breastbone where it meets the soft upper belly. Use light pressure.

name: Danzhong (Chest Centre)
location_text: On the middle of the chest, on the breastbone, level with the space between the 4th and 5th ribs (count down from the collarbone). In many men this is nipple height.

name: Yutang (Jade Hall)
location_text: On the middle of the breastbone, level with the space between the 3rd and 4th ribs, about two finger-widths above the 4th-rib level of the chest centre.

name: Zigong (Purple Palace)
location_text: On the middle of the breastbone, level with the gap between the 2nd and 3rd ribs, a few finger-widths below the collarbone line.

name: Huagai (Splendid Canopy)
location_text: On the upper part of the breastbone, in line with the first gap between ribs just below the collarbone, about a thumb-width below the next point up.

name: Xuanji (Jade Pivot)
location_text: On the upper breastbone, about one thumb-width below the hollow at the base of the throat.

name: Tiantu (Heaven Projection)
location_text: In the soft hollow at the base of the throat, just above the top of the breastbone, between the inner ends of the collarbones. Use very light pressure.

name: Lianquan (Ridge Spring)
location_text: On the front midline of the neck, in the dip just above the bony hyoid ridge, between the chin and the Adam's apple. Use very light pressure.

name: Chengjiang (Sauce Receptacle)
location_text: On the chin, in the middle of the dip between the lower lip and the point of the chin. Press lightly.

name: Shuifen (Water Separation)
location_text: On the upper belly, on the midline, about one thumb-width above the navel.

name: Tongziliao (Pupil Crevice)
location_text: On the face, in the small hollow on the bony rim just beside the outer corner of the eye, about half a thumb-width out.

name: Fubai (Floating White)
location_text: Behind the ear, roughly level with the top of the ear, about a thumb-width into the hair, on the curve running down toward the bony bump behind the earlobe.

name: Touqiaoyin (Head Portal Yin)
location_text: Behind the ear, in the hair just above and behind the bony bump behind the earlobe, about two thirds of the way down the curve from the top of the ear to the hollow below that bump.

name: Wangu (Completion Bone)
location_text: Just behind and below the bony bump behind the earlobe, in the soft hollow there.

name: Benshen (Root of the Spirit)
location_text: On the forehead just inside the hairline, a little above the outer end of the eyebrow line, about four finger-widths out from the middle of the forehead.

name: Yangbai (Yang White)
location_text: On the forehead, straight above the pupil when looking ahead, about one thumb-width above the eyebrow.

name: Toulinqi (Head Overlooking Tears)
location_text: On the scalp straight above the pupil when looking ahead, about half a thumb-width back from the front edge of the hair.

name: Naokong (Brain Hollow)
location_text: On the back of the head, level with the top of the bony lump in the middle of the skull base, about three finger-widths out to the side, straight above the point in the neck hollow.

name: Tinghui (Auditory Convergence)
location_text: Just in front of the small notch at the bottom of the ear's front flap, in the hollow behind the jaw joint; it is easiest to feel with the mouth open.

name: Yuanye (Armpit Abyss)
location_text: On the side of the ribcage with the arm raised, about four finger-widths below the centre of the armpit, in the gap between two ribs.

name: Riyue (Sun and Moon)
location_text: Straight down from the nipple, count three rib gaps lower (the nipple sits at about the fourth gap; this is the seventh), near the lower edge of the rib cage. In women, go straight down from mid-collarbone.

name: Jingmen (Capital Gate)
location_text: On the side of the waist, just below the loose tip of the lowest rib, which you can feel behind the lower edge of the rib cage.

name: Daimai (Girdling Vessel)
location_text: On the side of the waist, just below the tip of the second-lowest floating rib, at about belly-button height.

name: Juliao (Squatting Bone Hole)
location_text: On the side of the hip, halfway between the front point of the hip bone and the bony bump on the outer upper thigh.

name: Shangguan (Upper Gate)
location_text: On the side of the face in front of the ear, in the dip just above the middle of the cheekbone arch.

name: Huantiao (Jumping Round)
location_text: On the buttock, about one-third of the way from the bony bump on the outer hip toward the dip above the tailbone. Easiest to find lying on your side with the top knee bent.

name: Xiyangguan (Knee Yang Joint)
location_text: On the outer side of the knee, in the soft dip just above the knob of the thigh bone, between the thick outer band and the hamstring tendon behind it.

name: Yanglingquan (Yang Mound Spring)
location_text: On the outer side of the leg, in the soft hollow just in front of and below the knob of bone below the outer knee.

name: Yangjiao (Yang Intersection)
location_text: On the outer lower leg, about seven thumb-widths (a little over two hand-widths) above the outer ankle bone, just behind the thin outer shin bone.

name: Waiqiu (Outer Hill)
location_text: On the outer lower leg, about seven thumb-widths (a little over two hand-widths) above the outer ankle bone, on the front edge of the thin outer shin bone.

name: Guangming (Bright Light)
location_text: On the outer lower leg, about five thumb-widths above the ankle bone, on the front edge of the thin outer shin bone.

name: Yangfu (Yang Assistance)
location_text: On the outer lower leg, about four thumb-widths above the ankle bone, just in front of the thin outer shin bone.

name: Xuanzhong (Suspended Bell)
location_text: On the outer lower leg, about three thumb-widths (four finger-widths) above the outer ankle bone, in the dip on the front edge of the thin outer shin bone.

name: Hanyan (Jaw Serenity)
location_text: On the temple inside the hairline, about a quarter of the way down the gentle curve from the forehead corner of the hairline to just above the ear.

name: Qiuxu (Hill Ruins)
location_text: In front of and below the outer ankle bone, in the hollow on the outer side of the tendon that runs to the little toes (lift the toes to see it).

name: Zulinqi (Foot Overlooking Tears)
location_text: On top of the foot, in the groove between the bones of the fourth and little toes, just in front of where they meet, on the outer side of the tendon to the little toe.

name: Diwuhui (Earth Fivefold Convergence)
location_text: On top of the foot, in the groove between the bones of the fourth and little toes, just behind the knuckle of the fourth toe.

name: Xiaxi (Pinched Ravine)
location_text: On top of the foot, in the web between the fourth and little toes, a bit toward the ankle from the edge of the skin fold.

name: Zuqiaoyin (Foot Portal Yin)
location_text: On the outer side of the fourth toe, at the corner of the nail, a hair's breadth behind the nail edge.

name: Xuanlu (Suspended Skull)
location_text: On the temple inside the hairline, halfway along the gentle curve from the forehead corner of the hairline to the point just above and in front of the ear.

name: Xuanli (Suspended Tuft)
location_text: On the temple inside the hairline, about three-quarters of the way down the gentle curve from the forehead corner toward the front of the ear.

name: Qubin (Temporal Hairline Curve)
location_text: At the temple, where the hairline in front of the ear curves, level with the top of the ear. Press in the small dip there.

name: Shuaigu (Valley Lead)
location_text: On the side of the head, about two finger-widths straight above the tip of the ear. It is easier to feel while you chew.

name: Tianchong (Celestial Hub)
location_text: Above and behind the ear: from the back edge of where the ear joins the head, go straight up about two and a half finger-widths into the hair, a fingertip behind the point above the ear tip.

name: Lingtai (Spirit Tower)
location_text: On the midline of the upper back, in the dip under the 6th chest-level spine bump, just above the lower tips of the shoulder blades.

name: Shendao (Spirit Path)
location_text: On the midline of the upper back, in the dip under the 5th chest-level spine bump, between the shoulder blades.

name: Shenzhu (Body Pillar)
location_text: On the midline of the upper back, in the dip under the 3rd chest-level spine bump, level with where the shoulder-blade ridge meets the spine.

name: Taodao (Kiln Path)
location_text: On the midline of the upper back, in the dip under the first chest-level spine bump, just below the big bump at the base of the neck.

name: Dazhui (Great Hammer)
location_text: At the base of the neck on the midline, in the dip just under the biggest bump you feel when you tilt your head forward.

name: Yamen (Gate of Muteness)
location_text: On the back of the neck, on the midline, about half a thumb-width above the hairline: in the hollow just above the first bony bump you feel at the top of the neck, below the base of the skull. Press lightly.

name: Fengfu (Wind Mansion)
location_text: On the back of the head, on the midline just below the bony bump at the base of the skull, in the hollow between the two neck muscles.

name: Naohu (Brain's Door)
location_text: On the midline at the back of the head, in the hollow just above the bony bump at the base of the skull.

name: Qiangjian (Unyielding Space)
location_text: On the midline at the back of the head, about two finger-widths above the hollow that sits just over the bony bump at the base of the skull.

name: Houding (Behind the Summit)
location_text: On the midline at the back of the top of the head, about two finger-widths behind the very top of the head.

name: Baihui (Hundred Meetings)
location_text: At the very top of the head on the midline, a little forward of halfway between the front and back hairlines; also where a line joining the tips of both folded-forward ears crosses the midline.

name: Qianding (Before the Vertex)
location_text: On the midline of the scalp, about two finger-widths (one and a half thumb-widths) in front of the crown point at the very top of the head.

name: Xinhui (Fontanelle Meeting)
location_text: On the midline of the scalp, about two thumb-widths behind the front hairline.

name: Shangxing (Upper Star)
location_text: On the midline of the scalp, one thumb-width behind the front hairline.

name: Shenting (Courtyard of the Spirit)
location_text: On the midline of the scalp, half a thumb-width behind the front hairline.

name: Suliao (White Crevice)
location_text: On the very tip of the nose, at the centre of the rounded end.

name: Duiduan (Extremity of the Mouth)
location_text: On the midline of the upper lip, at the middle of the small bump in the centre of the lip edge.

name: Yaoyangguan (Lumbar Yang Gate)
location_text: On the midline of the lower back, in the dip under the bump of the spine level with the top of your hip bones.

name: Mingmen (Life Gate)
location_text: On the midline of the lower back, in the dip under the second lower-back bump, roughly level with the navel on the front.

name: Xuanshu (Suspended Pivot)
location_text: On the midline of the lower back, in the dip just under the first lower-back spine bump, one bump above the point level with the navel.

name: Jizhong (Spine Centre)
location_text: On the midline of the back, in the dip under the 11th chest-level spine bump, near the lowest ribs.

name: Zhongshu (Central Pivot)
location_text: On the midline of the back, in the dip under the 10th chest-level spine bump, just above the waist.

name: Jinsuo (Muscle Contraction)
location_text: On the midline of the mid-back, in the dip under the 9th chest-level spine bump, about two bumps below the level of the lower tips of the shoulder blades.

name: Zhiyang (Extremely Yang)
location_text: On the midline of the mid-back, in the dip under the 7th chest-level spine bump, level with the lower tips of the shoulder blades.

name: Qingling (Green Spirit)
location_text: On the inner side of the upper arm, just along the inner edge of the biceps muscle, about four finger-widths above the elbow crease.

name: Shaohai (Lesser Sea)
location_text: On the inner side of the elbow, with the elbow bent, in the dip just in front of the bony bump on the inside, level with the end of the elbow crease.

name: Lingdao (Spirit Path)
location_text: On the palm side of the forearm, on the little-finger side, about two finger-widths above the wrist crease, beside the tendon that stands out there.

name: Tongli (Connecting Li)
location_text: On the palm side of the forearm, about one thumb-width above the wrist crease, on the thumb side of the tendon on the little-finger edge.

name: Yinxi (Yin Cleft)
location_text: On the palm side of the forearm, half a thumb-width above the wrist crease, on the thumb side of the tendon on the little-finger edge.

name: Shaofu (Lesser Mansion)
location_text: On the palm, between the bones of the ring and little fingers, just behind the knuckles, where the little fingertip lands when you make a fist.

name: Shaochong (Lesser Surge)
location_text: On the little finger, on the thumb-side edge, right at the corner of the nail, just behind the nail's base.

name: Yingu (Yin Valley)
location_text: On the back of the knee, at the inner end of the crease when the knee is bent, just outside the tendon you can feel on the inner side.

name: Huangshu (Huang's Shu)
location_text: On the belly, right beside the navel, half a thumb-width out to the side.

name: Shangqu (Shang Bend)
location_text: On the upper belly, about three finger-widths above the navel, half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Shiguan (Stone Pass)
location_text: On the upper belly, about four finger-widths above the navel, half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Yindu (Yin Metropolis)
location_text: On the upper belly, about four thumb-widths above the navel, half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Rangu (Blazing Valley)
location_text: On the inner edge of the foot, just below the bony bump in the middle of the arch, where the darker top skin meets the paler sole skin.

name: Futonggu (Abdominal Passage)
location_text: On the upper belly, about five thumb-widths above the navel, half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Youmen (Hidden Gate)
location_text: On the upper belly, about six thumb-widths above the navel, below the ribs, half a thumb-width to the side of the midline.

name: Bulang (Corridor Walk)
location_text: On the chest, in the gap between the fifth and sixth ribs, about two thumb-widths out from the middle of the breastbone.

name: Shenfeng (Spirit Seal)
location_text: On the chest, in the gap between the fourth and fifth ribs, about two thumb-widths out from the middle of the breastbone.

name: Lingxu (Spirit Burial Ground)
location_text: On the chest, in the gap between the third and fourth ribs, about two thumb-widths out from the middle of the breastbone.

name: Shencang (Spirit Storehouse)
location_text: On the upper chest, in the gap between the second and third ribs, about two thumb-widths out from the middle of the breastbone.

name: Yuzhong (Lively Middle)
location_text: On the upper chest, in the gap between the first and second ribs, about two thumb-widths out from the middle of the breastbone.

name: Shufu (Shu Mansion)
location_text: On the upper chest, in the dip just under the collarbone, about two thumb-widths out from the middle of the breastbone.

name: Taixi (Greater Stream)
location_text: On the inner ankle, in the hollow halfway between the inner ankle bone and the Achilles tendon, level with the tip of the bone.

name: Dazhong (Great Bell)
location_text: On the inner heel area, just behind and below the inner ankle bone, in the dip in front of where the Achilles tendon meets the heel.

name: Shuiquan (Water Spring)
location_text: On the inner side of the heel, about one thumb-width below the hollow behind the inner ankle bone, in the dip in front of the heel bump.

name: Zhaohai (Shining Sea)
location_text: On the inner ankle, in the hollow about one thumb-width straight below the tip of the inner ankle bone.

name: Fuliu (Returning Flow)
location_text: On the inner lower leg, about two thumb-widths above the inner ankle bone, at the front edge of the Achilles tendon.

name: Jiaoxin (Intersection Reach)
location_text: On the inner lower leg, about two thumb-widths above the inner ankle bone, just behind the edge of the shin bone and a little in front of the Achilles tendon.

name: Zhubin (Guest House)
location_text: On the inner lower calf, about five thumb-widths above the inner ankle bone, in the groove between the bottom of the calf muscle and the Achilles tendon.

name: Shangyang (Shang Yang)
location_text: On the index finger, on the side nearest the thumb, just beside the base corner of the fingernail.

name: Shousanli (Arm Three Miles)
location_text: On the thumb-side back of the forearm, about three finger-widths below the outer end of the elbow crease, in the thick muscle.

name: Zhouliao (Elbow Bone-Hole)
location_text: On the outer elbow, about one thumb-width above the bony knob on the outside of the elbow, at the front edge of the ridge there.

name: Shouwuli (Arm Five Miles)
location_text: On the outer upper arm, about four finger-widths above the outer end of the elbow crease, on the line up to the shoulder.

name: Binao (Upper Arm)
location_text: On the outer upper arm, about three-quarters of the way up from the elbow crease to the armpit, just in front of the lower tip of the rounded shoulder muscle.

name: Jianyu (Shoulder Bone)
location_text: On the outer front of the shoulder, in the hollow just in front of and below the bony tip of the shoulder, easiest to feel when you lift your arm out to the side.

name: Jugu (Great Bone)
location_text: On the top of the shoulder, in the groove between the outer end of the collarbone and the ridge of the shoulder blade, near the shoulder tip.

name: Tianding (Heaven's Tripod)
location_text: On the side of the neck, about one thumb-width below the level of the Adam's apple, just behind the back edge of the thick neck muscle. Light touch only.

name: Futu (Support the Prominence)
location_text: On the side of the neck, level with the Adam's apple, in the gap between the two parts of the thick neck muscle. Light touch only, beside the pulse.

name: Kouheliao (Mouth Grain-Hole)
location_text: On the upper lip area, directly below the outer edge of the nostril, level with the middle of the groove under the nose.

name: Erjian (Second Interval)
location_text: On the thumb side of the index finger, in the small dip just past the big knuckle toward the fingertip, where the darker skin meets the paler skin.

name: Yingxiang (Welcome Fragrance)
location_text: On the face in the groove beside the nostril, level with the middle of the outer edge of the nostril wing.

name: Sanjian (Third Interval)
location_text: On the back of the hand, in the hollow on the thumb side of the index finger's big knuckle, just on the wrist side of it.

name: Yangxi (Yang Stream)
location_text: On the back of the wrist at the thumb side, in the little hollow that appears between the two thumb tendons when you lift your thumb up.

name: Pianli (Veering Passage)
location_text: On the thumb-side back of the forearm, about four finger-widths above the wrist crease, on the line toward the outer elbow.

name: Wenliu (Warm Dwelling)
location_text: On the thumb-side back of the forearm, on the line toward the outer elbow, a little under halfway from the wrist crease to the elbow crease (about five thumb-widths up).

name: Xialian (Lower Edge)
location_text: On the thumb-side back of the forearm, on the line to the wrist, about four finger-widths plus one thumb-width below the outer end of the elbow crease.

name: Shanglian (Upper Edge)
location_text: On the thumb-side back of the forearm, about four finger-widths below the outer end of the elbow crease, on the line to the wrist.

name: Dadun (Great Mound)
location_text: On the big toe, on the side facing the second toe, at the base corner of the toenail, just a hair back from where the nail meets the skin.

name: Zuwuli (Foot Five Miles)
location_text: On the inner upper thigh, about three thumb-widths below the groin fold, where you can feel a pulse.

name: Yinlian (Yin Corner)
location_text: On the inner upper thigh, about two thumb-widths below the groin fold, just outside the thick cord-like muscle of the inner thigh.

name: Zhangmen (Chapter Gate)
location_text: On the side of the belly, just below the tip of the second-lowest floating rib; lying on your side with your top arm raised helps you feel it.

name: Qimen (Cycle Gate)
location_text: On the chest, straight below the nipple, in the gap between the sixth and seventh ribs, two rib-gaps below nipple level. For women, go straight down from the middle of the collarbone to the same rib gap, under the breast.

name: Xingjian (Moving Between)
location_text: On the top of the foot, in the groove between the big toe and second toe, a little way back from the edge of the web, where the skin colour changes.

name: Zhongfeng (Mound Centre)
location_text: At the front of the inner ankle, in front of the ankle bump: lift your foot to make the thick tendon at the front of the ankle stand out, then press the soft dip just on the inner (big-toe) side of that tendon.

name: Ligou (Woodworm Canal)
location_text: On the inner shin, in the middle of the flat inner edge of the shinbone, about five thumb-widths above the ankle bone.

name: Zhongdu (Central Metropolis)
location_text: On the inner shin, in the middle of the flat inner edge of the shinbone, about seven thumb-widths above the ankle bone.

name: Xiguan (Knee Joint)
location_text: Just below the bony bump on the inner side of the knee, about one thumb-width behind the soft dip found there, at the top of the calf.

name: Ququan (Spring at the Bend)
location_text: With the knee bent, on the inner side of the knee, in the hollow just in front of the thick tendons at the inner end of the crease behind the knee.

name: Yinbao (Yin Bundle)
location_text: On the inner thigh, about four thumb-widths above the inner edge of the kneecap, in the groove between the two muscles there.

name: Zhongfu (Middle Palace)
location_text: On the upper chest near the shoulder, about one thumb-width below the soft hollow under the outer collarbone, level with the gap just below the first rib (about six thumb-widths out from the middle of the chest).

name: Yuji (Fish Border)
location_text: On the palm, along the edge of the thumb's fleshy pad, halfway down the long thumb-side hand bone where the darker skin meets the paler palm skin.

name: Shaoshang (Lesser Merchant)
location_text: On the outer edge of the thumb, just beside the base corner of the thumbnail, on the side away from the index finger.

name: Yunmen (Cloud Gate)
location_text: On the upper chest, in the soft hollow just under the outer end of the collarbone, on the chest side of the bony knob at the front of the shoulder.

name: Tianfu (Celestial Storehouse)
location_text: On the inner upper arm along the thumb side of the biceps muscle, about four finger-widths below the armpit fold.

name: Xiabai (Guarding White)
location_text: On the inner upper arm along the thumb side of the biceps muscle, about four finger-widths plus one thumb-width below the front armpit fold.

name: Chize (Cubit Marsh)
location_text: In the elbow crease with the arm bent, in the dip on the thumb side of the thick tendon in the middle of the crease.

name: Kongzui (Maximum Opening)
location_text: On the thumb side of the inner forearm, on the line from wrist to elbow, one thumb-width above the halfway point between the wrist crease and the elbow crease.

name: Jingqu (Channel Ditch)
location_text: On the thumb side of the inner forearm, one thumb-width above the wrist crease, between the wrist bone bump and the pulse.

name: Taiyuan (Great Abyss)
location_text: At the wrist crease on the thumb side, in the soft dip just beside where you feel the pulse. Press next to the pulse, not on it.

name: Tianchi (Heavenly Pool)
location_text: On the chest, in the space between the fourth and fifth ribs, about one thumb-width outside the nipple.

name: Tianquan (Heavenly Spring)
location_text: On the inner upper arm, in the groove between the two heads of the biceps muscle, about two to three finger-widths below the front armpit fold.

name: Quze (Marsh at the Bend)
location_text: In the middle of the inner elbow crease, on the little-finger side of the thick tendon. Press beside the pulse, not on it.

name: Ximen (Cleft Gate)
location_text: On the inner forearm, between the two central tendons, about six to seven finger-widths above the wrist crease.

name: Jianshi (Intermediary)
location_text: On the inner forearm, between the two central tendons, about four finger-widths above the wrist crease.

name: Daling (Great Mound)
location_text: On the inner wrist, in the middle of the wrist crease, between the two central tendons.

name: Laogong (Labour Palace)
location_text: In the middle of the palm, between the bones leading to the index and middle fingers, where the middle fingertip lands when you make a loose fist.

name: Zhongchong (Middle Rushing)
location_text: At the very tip of the middle finger, in the centre.

name: Shaoze (Lesser Marsh)
location_text: On the little finger, on the outer side (away from the ring finger), a hair's breadth behind the base corner of the nail.

name: Naoshu (Upper Arm Shu)
location_text: At the back of the shoulder, above the back armpit fold, in the dip just under the ridge of the shoulder blade.

name: Tianzong (Celestial Gathering)
location_text: On the shoulder blade, in the dip in the middle of the flat area below the ridge, about a third of the way down from the ridge toward the bottom tip of the blade.

name: Bingfeng (Grasping the Wind)
location_text: On the top of the shoulder blade, in the hollow above the middle of its ridge, in the muscle you can squeeze at the top of the shoulder.

name: Quyuan (Crooked Wall)
location_text: On the top of the shoulder blade, in the hollow just above the inner end of its ridge, about halfway between the back of the shoulder and the spine at the second bump below the big bump at the base of the neck.

name: Jianwaishu (Outer Shoulder Shu)
location_text: On the upper back, beside the spine, about a hand's width (four fingers) out from the first bump below the neck bump, level with the inner edge of the shoulder blade.

name: Jianzhongshu (Middle Shoulder Shu)
location_text: On the upper back, about three finger-widths (two thumb-widths) out to the side of the big bump at the base of the neck, level with its lower edge.

name: Tianchuang (Heavenly Window)
location_text: On the side of the neck, just behind the big neck muscle running from ear to collarbone, level with the Adam's apple.

name: Tianrong (Heavenly Appearance)
location_text: On the side of the neck, just behind the angle of the jaw, in the dip right in front of the big neck muscle.

name: Quanliao (Cheek Bone Crevice)
location_text: On the face, in the dip along the lower edge of the cheekbone, straight below the outer corner of the eye.

name: Tinggong (Listening Palace)
location_text: Just in front of the little flap at the ear opening, in the dip that appears when you open your mouth slightly.

name: Qiangu (Front Valley)
location_text: On the outer side of the little finger, in the small dip just in front of the knuckle where it meets the hand, at the line where the skin colour changes.

name: Yanggu (Yang Valley)
location_text: On the little-finger side of the back of the wrist, in the hollow between the small knob of the forearm bone and the wrist bone next to it.

name: Yanglao (Nursing the Aged)
location_text: On the back of the forearm just above the wrist, on the little-finger side. Turn your palm toward your chest and feel for the cleft beside the knob of the forearm bone.

name: Xiaohai (Small Sea)
location_text: On the back of the elbow, in the groove between the pointy tip of the elbow and the bony bump on the inner side. Press lightly, as the nerve here is sensitive.

name: Jianzhen (True Shoulder)
location_text: At the back of the shoulder, behind and below the joint, about one thumb-width above the end of the back armpit fold when the arm hangs down.

name: Yinbai (Hidden White)
location_text: On the inner side of the big toe, right at the corner of the nail, just behind the nail's base.

name: Xuehai (Sea of Blood)
location_text: On the inner thigh, about two thumb-widths above the inner upper corner of the kneecap, on the bulge of the thigh muscle that stands out when the knee is bent.

name: Jimen (Winnower Gate)
location_text: On the inner thigh, about a third of the way down from the groin crease to the knee, in the groove between the front and inner thigh muscles where a pulse can be felt. Press beside the pulse, not on it.

name: Daheng (Great Horizontal)
location_text: On the belly, level with the navel, four thumb-widths (a hand-width plus a thumb-width) out to the side of it.

name: Fuai (Abdominal Sorrow)
location_text: On the upper belly, about four finger-widths above the navel and four thumb-widths (a hand-width plus a thumb-width) out to the side, near the lower edge of the ribs.

name: Shidou (Food Hole)
location_text: On the side of the chest, in the soft gap between the fifth and sixth ribs, six thumb-widths (two hand-widths) out from the center of the breastbone.

name: Tianxi (Heavenly Stream)
location_text: On the side of the chest, in the soft gap between the fourth and fifth ribs, a little outside the nipple line.

name: Xiongxiang (Chest Village)
location_text: On the side of the upper chest, in the soft gap between the third and fourth ribs, well outside the breastbone.

name: Dadu (Great Metropolis)
location_text: On the inner side of the big toe, just in front of the big knuckle joint, where the skin changes from the top of the foot to the sole.

name: Zhourong (All-Round Flourishing)
location_text: On the upper chest, in the soft gap between the second and third ribs, well out to the side of the breastbone, below the collarbone.

name: Dabao (Great Embracement)
location_text: On the side of the chest, in the soft gap between the sixth and seventh ribs, straight down from the middle of the armpit.

name: Taibai (Supreme White)
location_text: On the inner edge of the foot, in the hollow just behind the big knuckle joint, where the skin changes from top-of-foot to sole.

name: Gongsun (Grandfather Grandson)
location_text: On the inner edge of the foot, in the hollow just in front of and below the bump at the base of the big toe's long bone, where the skin changes color.

name: Shangqiu (Shang Hill)
location_text: On the inside of the ankle, in the soft hollow just in front of and below the inner ankle bone, halfway between that bone and the bump in front of it.

name: Lougu (Leaking Valley)
location_text: On the inside of the lower leg, about eight finger-widths above the inner ankle bone (twice as high as the point four finger-widths up), just behind the edge of the shin bone.

name: Diji (Earth Pivot)
location_text: On the inside of the lower leg, about four finger-widths below the hollow under the knee's bony bump, just behind the edge of the shin bone.

name: Yinlingquan (Yin Mound Spring)
location_text: On the inside of the leg just below the knee, in the hollow where the shin bone's edge meets the underside of the bony bump below the inner knee.

name: Shuitu (Water Prominence)
location_text: On the front of the neck, along the front edge of the large neck muscle, a little below the level of the Adam's apple, about halfway between the carotid pulse and the inner end of the collarbone.

name: Qishe (Qi Abode)
location_text: At the base of the front of the neck, in the small dip just above the inner end of the collarbone, between the two tendons of the neck muscle.

name: Quepen (Empty Basin)
location_text: In the hollow just above the middle of the collarbone, in line with the nipple, in the dip at the base of the side of the neck.

name: Qihu (Qi Door)
location_text: On the upper chest, just below the middle of the collarbone, four thumb-widths out from the breastbone midline, straight above the nipple.

name: Kufang (Storeroom)
location_text: On the upper chest, in the gap between the first and second ribs, four thumb-widths out from the breastbone midline, straight above the nipple.

name: Wuyi (Roof)
location_text: On the chest, in the gap just below the second rib, four thumb-widths out from the breastbone midline, straight above the nipple. The second rib joins the breastbone at its raised ridge.

name: Yingchuang (Breast Window)
location_text: On the chest, in the gap between the third and fourth ribs, four thumb-widths out from the breastbone midline, just above the nipple.

name: Rugen (Breast Root)
location_text: On the chest, directly below the nipple in the gap between the fifth and sixth ribs. In women it is at the crease under the breast.

name: Burong (Not Contained)
location_text: On the upper belly, on both sides, just under the rib edge, about two hand-widths above the navel and about three finger-widths out from the midline.

name: Sibai (Four Whites)
location_text: On the face, about a thumb-width straight below the pupil when looking ahead, in the small dip in the cheekbone just under the eye socket.

name: Chengman (Assuming Fullness)
location_text: On the upper belly, five thumb-widths above the navel and two thumb-widths out from the midline, about one thumb-width below the lower edge of the ribs.

name: Liangmen (Beam Gate)
location_text: On the upper belly, four thumb-widths above the belly button and two thumb-widths out from the midline.

name: Guanmen (Pass Gate)
location_text: On the upper belly, three thumb-widths above the belly button and two thumb-widths out from the midline.

name: Taiyi (Supreme Unity)
location_text: On the upper belly, two thumb-widths above the navel and two thumb-widths out to the side of the midline.

name: Huaroumen (Slippery Flesh Gate)
location_text: On the upper belly, one thumb-width above the navel and two thumb-widths out to the side of the midline.

name: Juliao (Great Crevice)
location_text: On the face, straight below the pupil when looking ahead, level with the bottom of the nostril wing, just outside the crease running from nose to mouth.

name: Biguan (Thigh Joint)
location_text: On the upper front of the thigh, straight below the bony point at the front of the hip, level with the bottom of the pubic bone, in the soft dip between the thigh muscles.

name: Futu (Crouching Rabbit)
location_text: On the front-outer thigh, about six thumb-widths above the top of the kneecap, on the line toward the hip bone's front point.

name: Yinshi (Yin Market)
location_text: On the front-outer thigh, about three thumb-widths above the top of the kneecap, just outside the large thigh tendon.

name: Liangqiu (Beam Hill)
location_text: On the front-outer thigh, about two thumb-widths above the top of the kneecap, in the groove between the thigh tendon and the outer thigh muscle.

name: Dubi (Calf's Nose)
location_text: With the knee bent, in the hollow just below the kneecap on its outer side, beside the thick tendon under the kneecap.

name: Shangjuxu (Upper Great Hollow)
location_text: On the front of the lower leg, about six thumb-widths below the knee hollow and one finger-width outside the shin bone, in the muscle.

name: Tiaokou (Ribbon Opening)
location_text: On the front of the lower leg, about eight thumb-widths below the knee hollow, one finger-width outside the shin bone, roughly midway to the ankle.

name: Xiajuxu (Lower Great Hollow)
location_text: On the front of the lower leg, about nine thumb-widths below the knee hollow and one finger-width outside the shin bone, a little below the midpoint.

name: Dicang (Earth Granary)
location_text: On the face, just beside the corner of the mouth, about half a finger-width out, on the line of the crease that runs down from the nose.

name: Fenglong (Abundant Bulge)
location_text: On the front-outer lower leg, halfway between the knee and the ankle bone, about two finger-widths outside the sharp edge of the shin bone, in the muscle.

name: Jiexi (Ravine Divide)
location_text: On the front of the ankle, in the middle of the crease where foot meets leg, in the hollow between the two big tendons. They stand out when you lift your toes.

name: Chongyang (Rushing Yang)
location_text: On the top of the foot, at the highest part of the arch, where you can feel a pulse. Press gently beside the pulse, not on it.

name: Xiangu (Sunken Valley)
location_text: On the top of the foot, in the groove between the bones leading to the second and third toes, in the hollow just behind the toe knuckle.

name: Neiting (Inner Courtyard)
location_text: On the top of the foot, just behind the web between the second and third toes, in the small dip beside the base of the second toe.

name: Lidui (Strict Exchange)
location_text: On the second toe, at the outer corner of the nail, right where the side edge meets the base of the nail.

name: Daying (Great Welcome)
location_text: On the jaw, just in front of the angle of the jawbone, in the dip at the front edge of the chewing muscle. You may feel a pulse there; press beside it, lightly.

name: Jiache (Jaw Chariot)
location_text: On the jaw, about one finger-width in front of and above the angle of the jawbone, where the chewing muscle bulges when you clench your teeth.

name: Xiaguan (Below the Joint)
location_text: On the side of the face, about a finger-width in front of the ear, in the hollow just under the cheekbone arch. With your mouth closed you feel a dip; it fills when you open your mouth.

name: Touwei (Head Corner)
location_text: At the corner of the forehead on each side, about half a thumb-width inside the hairline, where the hairline turns back toward the temple.

name: Guanchong (Passage Hub)
location_text: On the little-finger side of the ring finger, just behind the corner of the nail, where the side of the nail meets its base.

name: Tianjing (Heavenly Well)
location_text: On the back of the arm, about one thumb-width above the tip of the elbow, in the hollow you feel when the elbow is bent.

name: Qinglengyuan (Clear Cold Abyss)
location_text: On the back of the upper arm, about three finger-widths above the tip of the elbow, in the middle of the arm.

name: Xiaoluo (Dispersing Riverbed)
location_text: On the back of the upper arm, in the middle of the arm, five thumb-widths (a hand-width plus three finger-widths) above the tip of the elbow.

name: Naohui (Upper Arm Convergence)
location_text: On the back of the upper arm, about four finger-widths below the back corner of the shoulder bone, along the rear edge of the rounded shoulder muscle.

name: Jianliao (Shoulder Bone-hole)
location_text: On the back of the shoulder, in the dimple just behind and below the bony tip of the shoulder. It shows up when you raise the arm out to the side.

name: Tianliao (Heavenly Bone-hole)
location_text: On the upper back, just above the upper inner corner of the shoulder blade, about halfway between the top of the shoulder muscle and the inner end of the shoulder blade's upper edge.

name: Tianyou (Window of Heaven)
location_text: On the side of the neck, just behind the big neck muscle, level with the angle of the jaw.

name: Yifeng (Wind Screen)
location_text: Just behind the earlobe, in the soft hollow between the jawbone and the bony bump behind the ear.

name: Chimai (Spasm Vessel)
location_text: On the bony bump behind the ear, near its middle, in line with the curve that runs from behind the earlobe up around the ear.

name: Luxi (Skull Rest)
location_text: Behind the ear, on the curved line that runs from behind the earlobe up to the tip of the ear, about one-third of the way down from the tip.

name: Yemen (Fluid Gate)
location_text: On the back of the hand, in the small hollow just above the skin fold between the ring finger and little finger.

name: Jiaosun (Angle Vertex)
location_text: On the side of the head just above the tip of the ear. Fold the ear forward, and the spot is where the tip touches the scalp.

name: Ermen (Ear Gate)
location_text: In front of the ear, in the small dip just above the little flap at the ear opening. It deepens when you open your mouth slightly.

name: Erheliao (Ear Harmonic Bone-hole)
location_text: On the side of the head, just in front of the top of the ear and at the edge of the temple hair. You can feel a pulse right in front of it; stay behind that.

name: Sizhukong (Silk Bamboo Hole)
location_text: At the outer end of the eyebrow, in the small hollow on the bone.

name: Zhongzhu (Central Islet)
location_text: On the back of the hand, in the groove between the ring- and little-finger bones, just behind the knuckles on the wrist side.

name: Yangchi (Yang Pool)
location_text: On the back of the wrist, right on the crease, in the dip on the little-finger side of the bundle of finger tendons, in line with the gap between the ring- and little-finger bones.

name: Waiguan (Outer Pass)
location_text: On the back of the forearm, about three finger-widths above the wrist crease, in the groove between the two forearm bones, directly opposite the popular inner-wrist point.

name: Zhigou (Branch Ditch)
location_text: On the back of the forearm, about four finger-widths above the wrist crease, in the groove between the two forearm bones.

name: Huizong (Convergence and Gathering)
location_text: On the back of the forearm, about four finger-widths above the wrist crease, just beside the bone on the little-finger side, about one finger-width over from the middle of the forearm.

name: Sanyangluo (Three Yang Connection)
location_text: On the back of the forearm, in the groove between the two forearm bones, about one-third of the way from the wrist crease to the tip of the elbow.

name: Sidu (Four Rivers)
location_text: On the back of the forearm, in the groove between the two forearm bones, five thumb-widths (a hand-width plus three finger-widths) below the tip of the elbow.
